title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast Pod & Refill For 10K or 30K Device – Juicy Peach
description: Please Note: Compatible with Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K & 30K Kits Only Refresh your Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K vape kit with the Juicy Peach Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack. This sweet and mellow refill includes a 2ml prefilled pod and an 8ml refill container, both filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid in a smooth stone fruit flavour. Juicy Peach delivers the rich, velvety sweetness of sun-ripened Peach for a bright, well-rounded vape that’s simple yet endlessly satisfying. It’s a great everyday option for vapers who enjoy juicy, sweet summer fruit flavours with a smooth exhale. Each pod and refill pack is designed exclusively for the Dojo Blast 10K device and offers up to 10,000 puffs (device total), powered by Vaporesso's dual mesh coil and COREX 2.0 technology. The transparent pod design makes it easy to track your e-liquid levels, while the Smart Liq-Cycle system ensures steady coil saturation for consistently excellent flavour.
